scope: The Egyptian Museum on Tahrir Square in May 2019, with its pink Beaux-Arts elevations, vaulted central entrance, corner pavilions, roof lights and rear arches.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum identifies the 1902 building, the 15,000 square metre area and Marcel Dourgnon’s winning neoclassical scheme.
The Egyptian ministry describes two main museum floors and more than 100 galleries.
The Egyptian nomination describes the Beaux-Arts and Renaissance design, large arches and marble panels on the main elevation.
